restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเทพารักษ์ TDC
text:
The doctor has therapeutic skills, but communication with the patient is inappropriate, especially regarding the normal bodily reflex of the tongue. Repeatedly reprimanding the patient caused stress throughout the treatment. I have previously received treatment from another doctor (a female doctor) at the clinic who was excellent, so I regret the stark difference this time.
The patient did not move intentionally; it was a physical response that should have been understood by the medical staff.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเทพารักษ์ TDC
text: I'm terrified of having teeth extracted, but this was my first time here. The dentist was kind, the assistants were good, and the front desk staff were also polite. I had two molars extracted, and the dentist gave me a small discount. The extraction was very quick, less than 10 minutes, and it didn't hurt at all. Next time I need dental work done, I'll definitely come back here!

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเทพารักษ์ TDC
text:
I came here because it's close to home. Just a few dozen meters back, and I'm there.

My first time getting my teeth cleaned was 700 baht, plus 800 baht for one cavity filling. The price was very reasonable.

I made the right decision coming here. If I had gone to another place where my girlfriend had braces, I would have definitely spent 2,000 baht.
